messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Flonase is a nasal spray containing fluticasone propionate. Fluticasone propionate is a corticosteroid that reduces inflammation in the lining of the nose.
Flonase Nasal Spray is used to treat nasal congestion, sneezing, runny nose, and itchy or watery eyes caused by seasonal or year-round allergies.
Flonase Allergy Relief is for use in adults and children who are at least 4 years old and is available without a prescription. Children's Flonase Allergy Relief contains the same medicine and is also for ages 4 and older.
Flonase Sensimist contains fluticasone furoate rather than fluticasone propionate and is approved for use in adults and children 2 years of age and older. Children's Flonase Sensimist is also for ages 2 and older. In Flonase Sensimist labeling, relief of itchy, watery eyes applies to ages 12 and older.
The brand-name prescription version of Flonase nasal spray has been discontinued in the United States. Generic fluticasone propionate nasal spray is still available by prescription, and over-the-counter Flonase products and store brands remain on the market.
Triplet: ["fluticasone propionate", "reduces", "inflammation in the lining of the nose"]

The relation 'reduces' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance decreases or lessens the condition or effect specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'helps reduce': The subject drug is used to decrease or lessen the condition or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has reduced efficacy in': The subject drug may be less effective in patients with the condition or factor specified by the object entity.
C. 'lowers level of': The subject drug decreases the level of the substance or biomarker specified by the object entity in the body.
D. 'affected by': The subject entity is influenced or altered by the factor specified by the object entity.
E. 'involves buildup of': The subject condition involves the accumulation of the substance specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
